claims: Graco has issued a voluntary recall for approximately 5,126 SnugRide Turn & Slide Rotating Infant Car Seats manufactured Dec 1, 2025–March 27, 2026.
The recall is due to a structural defect where the seat may detach from the base during a crash.
The affected products were sold between January and March 2026 at major retailers.
The affected models are SnugRide Turn & Slide models numbers 2231809, 2231887, 2231806, 2231885, 2231881, 2231884.
No other Graco products or rotating car seats are affected.
The car seat base has a white label with the model number and manufactured date.
The seat can still be used for travel without the base installed via seat belt.
A free replacement kit is available.
There is an official Graco SnugRide Turn & Slide Recall website.
There is an Instagram post regarding the Graco Turn & Slide recall.
